personal_info.summary: I am a proactive software developer with hands-on experience in backend development and master data management, particularly in SAP environments. I have worked with technologies such as C#, ASP.NET Core, and .NET 6+, building and maintaining RESTful APIs and contributing to scalable backend solutions. My background also includes freelance experience developing microservices with Java, Spring Boot, and Spring Security with JWT. I am proficient in SQL and experienced in reporting tools like TOAD, and I enjoy automating processes using advanced Excel techniques. I’m familiar with Entity Framework, Git, and object-oriented programming principles. I value clean, maintainable code and enjoy collaborating in Agile teams to continuously improve technical and operational processes. My strong English communication skills and commitment to learning allow me to adapt quickly, support cross-functional collaboration, and deliver quality-driven software solutions.
